login.metaDescription: Access your wish lists and the gifts you’ve reserved.
login.title: Log in
login.description: Access your wish lists and the gifts you’ve reserved.
login.badCredentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes before trying again.

register.metaTitle: Create an account — Oh, You Shouldn't!
register.metaDescription: Create an account to make and manage your wish lists. Friends and family can view them and reserve gifts without an account.
register.title: Create an account
register.description: Create an account to make and manage your wish lists. Friends and family can view them and reserve gifts without an account.
register.name: Display name
register.hasAccount: Already have an account? Log in
register.errorEmail: This email is already in use.
register.sent: If this address didn’t have an account, it does now and you’re logged in. If it already did, we emailed you a link to log in.
register.errorFields: Enter an email address, a password, and a name.
register.rateLimited: Too many sign-ups from this address. Try again later.
register.sentVerify: If this address had no account, it has been created and you are signed in: confirm your address with the link we just sent you (valid for 24 hours). If it already had one, an email invites you to sign in.
register.sendFailed: If this address had no account, it has been created and you are signed in. The email could not be sent for now: in a few minutes, request a new link from the banner at the top of the page.

forgot.metaTitle: Forgot your password — Oh, You Shouldn't!
forgot.metaDescription: Get a link to choose a new password.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your account’s email address. If it’s linked to an account, we’ll send you a link to choose a new password. The link is valid for 1 hour.
forgot.sent: If this email address is linked to an account, a password reset email has been sent. Check your spam folder too.
forgot.noMail: Email sending isn’t configured on this server. The link was written to data/password-reset.log.
forgot.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in an hour.

reset.metaDescription: Choose a password to log back in.
reset.title: New password
reset.description: Choose a password to sign back in. Use at least 10 characters.
reset.errorGeneric: We couldn’t save this password. Check it isn’t empty, or request a new link.

account.title: My account
account.subtitle: Manage your profile, sign-in address, reservations, and password.
account.profileHint: Your display name and login email address.
account.emailHint: This email address is used to sign in. To change it, use the “Sign-in address” card.
account.offersHint: Only reservations made with this account appear here. Reservations made while logged out aren’t shown.
account.offersEmpty: You haven’t reserved any gifts with this account yet.
account.offersEmptyHint: Open a shared wish list and select “Reserve this gift” while logged in.
account.dataHint: Legal notice, personal data, and a copy of your data.
account.exportHint: A JSON file with your account, your lists, their ideas and your reservations. No password, no invite link.
account.deleteHint: Your account and the lists nobody else is a member of will be erased. You will see the details before confirming.
account.deleteRemovedAccount: Your account and all its sign-ins, on the site and on your devices.
account.deleteRemovedLists_one: {{count}} list nobody else is a member of, with its ideas and reservations:
account.deleteRemovedLists_other: {{count}} lists nobody else is a member of, with their ideas and reservations:
account.deleteKeptLists_one: {{count}} shared list stays with its other members:
account.deleteKeptLists_other: {{count}} shared lists stay with their other members:
account.deleteKeptReservations_one: {{count}} gift you reserved stays reserved, under your name, with no account attached.
account.deleteKeptReservations_other: {{count}} gifts you reserved stay reserved, under your name, with no account attached.

emailChange.title: Sign-in address
emailChange.description: To sign in with another address, enter it with your current password. A confirmation link is sent to the new address.
emailChange.descriptionNoMail: To sign in with another address, enter it with your current password.
emailChange.pending: Change pending to {{email}}: open the link we sent there. Your sign-in address only changes then.
emailChange.sent: A confirmation link is on its way to the new address. It is valid for 24 hours.

apiKeys.title: API keys and AI assistants
apiKeys.hint: A key lets an assistant (Claude…) or a script act on your lists for you, through the MCP server below: read, add, edit and tidy ideas. It can’t change your password or email address, or export or delete your account. Changing or resetting your password revokes all your keys.
apiKeys.name: Key name
apiKeys.copyNow: Copy it now: it won’t be shown again.
apiKeys.revokeBody: “{{name}}” will no longer be able to access your lists. This takes effect immediately.
apiKeys.mcpHint: In your assistant, add an HTTP MCP server with this address, and the header “Authorization: Bearer” followed by your key.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.descriptionForced: First sign-in for {{email}}. You must set a new one before continuing.

confirmEmail.metaTitle: Confirm your address — Oh, You Shouldn't!
confirmEmail.title: Confirm your email address
confirmEmail.verified: Your email address is confirmed. You can now create lists and join your loved ones’ lists.
confirmEmail.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
confirmEmail.resendHint: You are signed in with an address that is not confirmed yet: request a new link.
confirmEmail.changeDescription: Confirm that you now want to sign in with {{email}}.
confirmEmail.changed: Your new sign-in address is confirmed. Use it to sign in.
confirmEmail.changedTo: Your sign-in address is now {{email}}. Use it to sign in.
confirmEmail.loginToResend: If your address is not confirmed yet, sign in: you can request a new link from the banner.

verifyBanner.message: Confirm your email address to create a list, join one or invite someone: open the link we sent you.
verifyBanner.sent: A new link is on its way. It is valid for 24 hours; check your spam folder too.
verifyBanner.failed: The email could not be sent. Try again in a few minutes.
verifyBanner.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in an hour.
verifyBanner.already: Your email address is already confirmed.
